title: Restore four standalone Git governor commands with optional hosted execution
goal: Vision: V-6. Reduce Susi core below 100k lines with zero functionality loss. Restore core-only integrate, submit-main, release-promote and retire-branches from the published Apache implementation, preserve paired MCP errors and write-once behavior, and fund the change within the measured size ceiling.

reuse.searched: The published Apache core at 43664bd065 contains the complete standalone Git implementation and regression fixtures. Commercial Apps already serves these operations through workflow_harness_v1. Reuse the authorized MCP session and existing Rust wire client. Windows rollback qualification reuses the native release harness and its pinned fixture binaries for the default and explicit SUSI_HOME paths.
